messages:
Nina (AE): FYI - MedPoint POC is greenlit to convert. They want a 12mo committed pool and will issue a PO once DPA/order form approved. Need quick help on signature order + minimal redline path.

Cal (SE): Security asked for SAML + SOC2. KMS BYOK is not needed for POC. We should note BYOK available for Private per SOW.

Renee (Legal): DPA redlines: they request 30-day data export + subprocessor approval. We can accept export window and notice for subprocessors; they lowered liability cap to 1x fees which we'll escalate. If they persist, need exec approval.

Marta (Procurement): For PO we need: legal entity name, tax id, remit address, PO number, and two authorized signers. Also prefer DocuSign sequencing: customer signs then vendor countersigns. Confirm who will supply signer names.

Nina (AE): I'll collect signers. Proposed billing snippet to include in OF:

```
Customer: MedPoint Labs, Inc.
Billing contact: ap@medpoint.com
Remit: 88 Clinical Way, Cambridge, MA 02139
Term: 12 months
Commit: $48,000/month
Billing terms: Net30
One-time onboarding credit: $5,000
```

Ben (Finance): Net30 OK. Add finance-billing@redwood.com as remit CC and include GL code mapping if they require PO-match. Also request anticipated PO number before invoicing.

Renee (Legal): Add e-sign clause: "Electronic signature (DocuSign) is equivalent to original." I'll prepare minimal countersign-friendly redline and escalate liability cap if needed.

Marta (Procurement): Sequence confirmed: customer signs OF+DPA -> Redwood countersigns same day -> customer issues PO referencing signed OF. If PO delayed, include "PO to follow" note so invoicing can proceed.

Nina (AE): Thanks. I'll send updated OF + DPA redline to MedPoint legal and loop in ops-privacy@redwood.com, finance-billing@redwood.com, and Renee for final sign-off. Will post replies here. :thumbsup:
